lines.text: God is known in Judah, and His tent is in Salem and His dwelling place in Zion.
There God shattered the flaming arrows, the shield, the sword and the weapons of war.
God is more majestic than the stars of heaven, and at His rebuke both horse and rider lie stunned.
From heaven God pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still when He rose up to save the lowly.
Even the wrath of man shall praise God, and neighboring lands bring soldiers to Him, who is feared by kings.
